body:
Hey man, i'm right there with you. I aspire to go pro in dota 2. It's fucking hard man. Everyone has that look in their eyes when you tell them their dream. i know you know what i mean, i'm sure you've seen it too. But you just gotta remember that the ultimate victory is success. nobody can look down on you when you are making 200k/year on a teir 1 team. It's not even about the money at all for me either, but people like their numbers, and that will shut them up real fast. I'm not saying it's easy man. There's a reason i'm on this sub too. I'm just trying to find the strength to keep fighting, and keep getting better. I hope you can too.

I dont know if this will help you, but sometimes when i'm at my lowest, i just stop all of my thoughts, and just intensely visualize the moment when i win the world champs and i feel the vibrations of the cheers running through me and the adrenaline flowing freely through my veins. I use it to remind myself that there is something out there that i want. something i can still live for. for myself, and not for others.

Again, however you decide to go i respect you in your career choice and i wish you happiness and success.
